Maake Beauty – Where Elegance Meets Everyday Confidence

Maake Beauty is a modern cosmetics brand crafted for those who believe beauty should feel effortless, empowering, and luxuriously accessible. Our products are designed with precision, style, and care—blending high performance with striking aesthetics. From richly pigmented lipsticks to smooth kajal, defining eyeliners, and volumizing mascaras, every Maake Beauty creation enhances your natural features while adding a touch of sophistication.

With bold packaging, premium formulas, and a vision rooted in authenticity, Maake Beauty celebrates individuality and the art of self-expression. Whether you're elevating your daily routine or creating a glamorous look, Maake Beauty is your partner in confidence, charm, and timeless beauty.

Questions & Answers

Are Maake Beauty products suitable for all skin types?

Yes! Our products are formulated to be lightweight and breathable, blending seamlessly on every skin type.

Do you offer Cash on Delivery?

Yes, COD is available across Nepal and India for your convenience.

How long does delivery take?

Kathmandu Valley: 2-3 business days. Major cities: 3-5 days. Other regions: 5-7 business days.

Are your products cruelty-free?

Maake Beauty follows a clean beauty philosophy with gentle, skin-respecting formulations.

Makeup for Pigmented Skin and Acne Marks: How to Get an Even, Natural Look

Struggling with pigmentation, acne marks or uneven skin tone? Learn how to create an even, natural-looking makeup base without using too much product. From skin preparation to concealer placement, discover simple techniques for covering marks while keeping your makeup fresh and comfortable.

How to Choose the Right Lip Shade for Your Lip Undertone

Choosing the perfect lipstick is about more than your skin tone. Your natural lip color and undertone can affect how a lipstick looks once you apply it. Learn how to identify your lip undertone and choose shades that complement your natural coloring beautifully.

Latte Makeup Is Evolving: How to Create the Perfect Brown-Toned Look

Latte makeup continues to inspire soft, warm and effortlessly polished beauty looks. Learn how to create a modern brown-toned makeup look using warm neutrals, soft definition and flattering shades for everyday wear.
